objective.constraint_object: Quantity on a Purchase Receipt represented by request.body.qty, supplied quantity limit and authenticated role context
objective.constraint_kind: Receipt quantity allowance and the documented authorized-role exception
objective.scope: Implement the supplied Stock Settings quantity policy for this target; upstream supplies trusted derivedMaximumQty and authorizedRole. Do not add unrelated field, item, range or full-document validation.

snapshot_content_lines.text: This is the percentage you are allowed to receive or deliver more against the quantity ordered. For example: If you have ordered 100 units, Supplier sends 120 units and the percentage is set to 10% then you are allowed to receive 110 units. By default, this is set to 0.
### Role Allowed to Over Deliver/Receive
Users with this role are allowed to over deliver/receive against orders above the allowance percentage
### Show Barcode Field

objective.constraint_object: Supplier on-hold status and hold type relevant to Purchase Order creation
objective.constraint_kind: The documented supplier hold-type condition for the target operation
objective.scope: Implement the supplier hold policy for this Purchase Order target only; do not add restrictions for invoices, payments, other endpoints or unrelated fields.

snapshot_content_lines.text: The hold types are as follows:

+ Invoices: ERPNext will not allow Purchase Invoices or Purchase Orders to be created for the supplier + Payments: ERPNext will not allow Payment Entries to be created for the Supplier + All: ERPNext will apply both hold types aboveIf you do not set a release date, ERPNext will hold the Supplier **indefinitely**.
### 2.5 Default Payable Accounts
The hold types are as follows:

+ Invoices: ERPNext will not allow Purchase Invoices or Purchase Orders to be created for the supplier + Payments: ERPNext will not allow Payment Entries to be created for the Supplier + All: ERPNext will apply both hold types aboveIf you do not set a release date, ERPNext will hold the Supplier **indefinitely**.
### 2.5 Default Payable Accounts
